summary: Both files in this work unit contain substantial formal mathematical content — definitions, theorem statements, and proofs — directly formalizing key results from the cited papers. The first file (MultiBlock.lean) implements the multi-block asymmetric compression theorem (Theorem 7.7 from the P5 note) with its structure, biorthogonality, compression, remainder, nilpotency, and dimension clauses, plus the existence theorem. The second file (UnblockedPowerSumCoefficients.lean) proves the unblocked power-sum coefficient theorem from t1_unblocked.tex, including trace reduction into periodic representatives, matching-before-blocking exclusion, canonical expansion at every positive length with eventual rigidity, dimension bound, and uniqueness of weight multisets.
